description: Watch a place with EDK-1 and get each new sighting or event by webhook and in the EDK console the moment it appears. Use when the user wants to be told about change, not answered once. Tier 4 and above; each event is 0.2 CU.

area.description: A place name like "Pittsburgh", or "lat, lng".

artifacts.description: Up to five artifact names or ids, like ["Building Permit"].

prompt.description: What matters about these events. Saved; not used to filter yet.

since.description: Report events after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: a week ago.

webhook_url.description: A public https URL to receive events. Optional.

name: edk_monitor_create
